subject.title: feat(ui): path-based session and dashboard URLs

question: Should the released query-form session URLs be migrated through a redirect/canonical replacement, or is intentionally breaking every existing bookmark and ClickClack discussion link an accepted product decision?
rationale: The branch explicitly chooses a breaking URL-contract change, while the repository policy treats user-visible compatibility and removed fallbacks as merge-critical unless the permanent contract is intentionally approved.

options.title: Migrate existing deep links
options.body: Keep the new canonical path format but accept the old `session` and `face` query parameters long enough to resolve and replace them with the equivalent path.

options.title: Approve the breaking URL contract
options.body: Remove legacy support deliberately and document that all existing bookmarks and externally published Control UI links must be regenerated.

recommendation.title: Migrate existing deep links
recommendation.body: Keep the new canonical path format but accept the old `session` and `face` query parameters long enough to resolve and replace them with the equivalent path.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature history and active assignment connect this person most directly to the routing contract and its intended compatibility boundary.
